thread:
sarah.ng: Heads-up — we're planning an RBAC change for the Private control plane next week. Goal: tighten default service account permissions for on‑prem clusters + enforce namespace isolation. Need to confirm audit logging/KMS behavior and any rollout blockers.

mike.t: What's the exact change? removing cluster-admin from some controllers?

sarah.ng: Yes. Revoke cluster-admin from logging-agent and migrate it to a constrained role that only writes to customer-audit-index. Also enable Gatekeeper constraint to forbid cross-namespace secret access.

julia.k: +1 on Gatekeeper. We should deploy a constraint like this (rough sketch):

```
apiVersion: constraints.gatekeeper.sh/v1beta1
kind: K8sPSPNoHostNetwork
metadata:
  name: no-host-network
spec:
  enforcementAction: deny
```

mike.t: Will that break our onprem telemetry collector? It needs hostNetwork in some edge setups.

sarah.ng: Good catch. We should add an exception for the collector via an allowed label instead of broad hostNetwork allowlist. Thinking: label pods "shielded-edge: true" and add a Gatekeeper exception template.

ops-oncall: Also point of caution — when we change SA perms, connectors that sign tokens via KMS might fail if they can't read keystore. Confirm ServiceAccount -> IAM role mapping for private deployments before rollout.

devsec-bot: automated-scan: found 2 workloads in staging using default service account with wide perms. CI job: infra/priv-deploy/rbac-check failing on these. link: https://ci.internal/reports/2981

julia.k: For KMS integration: ensure audit log entries include key-id and requestor principal. On our private package, the keystore SDK logs only key-id unless audit-level=verbose; we need to flip that for prod to meet compliance.

mike.t: Audit retention question — Private customers want 1 year of immutable logs. Our current onprem stack uses local elasticsearch with 90d retention. Ops — can we support longer retention with S3 cold storage?

ops-oncall: We can tier: ship compressed daily indices to object store and apply immutability flags. Need to confirm encryption-at-rest uses customer KMS (BYOK) for Private. If using Redwood-managed keys we need opt-in.

sarah.ng: Action items: 1) julia to propose Gatekeeper constraint + exception PR (due EOD Thu). 2) mike to inventory controllers using cluster-admin (due Mon). 3) ops to validate KMS key policy + audit verbosity for Private (due Mon). 4) devsec to clear the two staging offenders and run rbac-check CI.

mike.t: Also recommend a canary rollout: apply RBAC change to one tenant cluster and run a 24hr smoke checklist (ingest, model-serving, audit events, keystore ops). If telemetry flakes, we rollback.

julia.k: I'll add a smoke checklist to the PR template: check audit entries for KMS ops include requester, verify Gatekeeper denies cross-namespace secret get.

ops-oncall: Incident playbook note: if a key-access failure is observed, we should rotate to fallback key and enable a read-only degraded mode for inference. Documented runbook path and Slack channel alerting needed.

sarah.ng: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll schedule the RBAC rollout for Wed next week, canary first. Tagging @mike.t @julia.k @ops-oncall for visibility. :white_check_mark:

mike.t: sounds good.

devsec-bot: reminder: open vuln ticket #SE-421 for staging default-SA issue.

sarah.ng: thanks — closing thread, will post PR links when ready.
